rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something cool, great, or excellent.

example.english: The decor of this newly opened cha chaan teng is really funky.
example.traditional: 呢間新開嘅茶記個裝修真係正。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 san1 hoi1 ge3 caa4 gei3 go3 zong1 sau1 zan1 hai6 zing3

rows.note: Use this for a person or thing that has an unpleasant or foul smell.

example.english: Your socks have been lying around for days; they’re really funky.
example.traditional: 你對襪擺咗幾日，真係臭。
example.jyutping: nei5 deoi3 mat6 baai2 zo2 gei2 jat6 zan1 hai6 cau3

rows.note: Use this for something eccentric or unusual, and in context for a person or thing that seems suspicious or not quite right.

example.english: This website wants you to pay before seeing the goods; the whole thing is funky.
example.traditional: 呢個網站要你先畀錢先睇貨，成件事好古怪。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 mong5 zaam6 jiu3 nei5 sin1 bei2 cin4 sin1 tai2 fo3 sing4 gin6 si6 hou2 gu2 gwaai3
